documents.key_passage_zh: 承接川气东送工程气源的江西省天然气管网一期工程已建成管道870公里，主要建成九江—南昌、九江-沙河、九江-景德镇、南昌-丰城、高安-新余、丰城-抚州 6条干线和田南-上高支线。承接西气东输二线、三线工程气源的江西省天然气管网二期工程已建成管道 98 公里，主要建成吉安首段、赣州首段、安义段 3 条管线和宜春、萍乡对接工程。
documents.key_passage_en: "The Jiangxi provincial natural gas pipeline network Phase I project, which receives gas from the Sichuan-East Gas Transmission project, has completed 870 km of pipeline, mainly building the 6 trunk lines Jiujiang-Nanchang, Jiujiang-Shahe, Jiujiang-Jingdezhen, Nanchang-Fengcheng, Gao'an-Xinyu, Fengcheng-Fuzhou, plus the Tiannan-Shanggao branch. The Phase II project, which receives gas from West-East Gas Pipeline Lines 2 and 3, has completed 98 km, mainly the Ji'an first section, Ganzhou first section, and Anyi section, plus the Yichun and Pingxiang interconnects."
documents.relevance: Names all six GEM Phase I trunk segments verbatim (incl. P4776 Fengcheng-Fuzhou, P4778 Gao'an-Xinyu, P4779 Jiujiang-Jingdezhen) as real, built, provincial DRC-recognized transmission pipelines — corroborates existence/classification/status for those three rows. Gives Phase I as-built total = 870 km as of the ~2012/2013 reporting baseline behind this 2014 document, vs. the GEM sheet's 825.00 km on P4777. Gap is 5.2% (45 km) — plausibly a different vintage/segment-count snapshot, NOT a literal match; do not cite this doc as directly supporting the '825.00' value, only as directional/existence corroboration for the aggregate row.

documents.key_passage_en_scale: Provincial gas network programme (Phase I + Phase II combined, per this 2025 vintage): total investment RMB 13.4 billion, build period Jan 2009-Dec 2022; as of end-March 2024, ~RMB 13.369 billion invested, ~3,182 km built, ~2,892 km in operation, ~87 transmission stations. NOTE: this document's own 'Phase I' definition (环鄰阳湖 ring, ~1,600 km planned) is a LATER/BROADER redefinition than the 2014 DRC plan's 'Phase I' (870 km built, the 6 named trunks) — the two documents use 一期/二期 terminology inconsistently across vintages. Do not treat the 2025 report's 'Phase I ~1,600 km planned' figure as commensurable with the 2014 report's 'Phase I 870 km built' figure or with the GEM row's 825.00 km — they are different scope definitions at different times.
